record.question: The shelf life of whole blood with CPDA is:
record.explanation: Answer D: 35 days. CPDA-1 whole blood is stored at 1–6 °C for up to 35 days under standard licensed product dating. Reference: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CFR-2023-title21-vol7/pdf/CFR-2023-title21-vol7-chapI-subchapF.pdf; https://cdsco.mohfw.gov.in/opencms/resources/UploadCDSCOWeb/2022/drug_rules/Drugs%20Rules%201945_2024%2009.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
